steps.text: Open a terminal in your project folder for the next steps.

measurements.context: M3 Pro, Metal: 3-4 GB peak memory, around 20 s per question

caveats: Not a chat model: it only runs inside colgrep as a code-search helper, so chat UIs cannot use it.
Every number here is LightOn's own. Their 52-question test covered code search only, not full coding tasks.
Accuracy: 80.8% vs 83.3% for plain grep. LightOn says the gap is not significant, but the 95% interval runs from -10.9 to +5.1 points.
It is slower: 21.6 s per question vs 13.0 s with grep. The Balanced mode saved 21% of tokens at grep's accuracy (17.7 s).
Savings grow with repo size: 19% under 50k lines, 40% at 150k-600k lines.
The last step hooks it into Claude Code. For Codex or OpenCode, LightOn's blog gives colgrep --install-codex and colgrep --install-opencode.
